title: Dinner Lady Berry Blast Short Fill
description: Blast off into a full-on fanfare of flavour with the booming berries of Berry Blast! Taken from Dinner Lady’s brand-new Fruits range, this high-VG e-juice is loaded with tender cherries mixed with tangy raspberries and promises to wage a war against bland flavour! The high-VG base of Berry Blast makes it ideal arsenal for your sub ohm setup whilst a generous 50ml bottle can accommodate a 10ml nicotine shot of your choice to tackle the irritation of cravings. Don’t wait to detonate this blistering berry blast!
